title: Noncommutative maximal inequalities for polynomial ergodic averages
summary: We prove a noncommutative maximal ergodic inequality for averages along polynomial sequences. Let $γ$ be a trace-preserving automorphism of a semifinite von Neumann algebra $(\mathcal N,τ)$. We show that the associated polynomial averages \begin{equation*} A_Nf:=\frac1N\sum_{n=1}^Nγ^{P(n)}(f), \qquad N\in\mathbb N, \end{equation*} satisfy a strong maximal inequality on $L_p(\mathcal N)$ for every $1<p<\infty$, extending the previously known restricted range of $p$.
